_comment: Optional config file. Copy to config.json (gitignored) and edit.
Precedence: environment variables > .env > this file > defaults,
so anything here can be overridden for a single run, e.g. PORT=9000 make dev.
Every key is optional; delete what you don't need.
A flat form using the env var names directly also works, e.g. "IPTV_USERNAME": "...".
